title: QUQ: Quadruplet Uniform Quantization for Efficient Vision Transformer Inference
problem: Vision transformers face quantization challenges where existing low-bit techniques cannot fully quantize the entire inference process, resulting in 22.3%-172.6% additional memory overhead compared to fully quantized models.
motivation: Efficient quantization of vision transformers is essential for practical deployment with reduced memory footprint and computational requirements.
method: QUQ divides the data range into at most four subranges, each uniformly quantized with different scale factors. An efficient relaxation algorithm determines optimal partition schemes and quantization parameters. Dedicated encoding and decoding strategies are designed to facilitate accelerator implementation.
key_novelty: Adaptive quadruplet uniform quantization that partitions data ranges into multiple subranges with different scale factors to handle diverse data distributions across vision transformers.
contributions: Proposes QUQ to handle various data distributions across the full vision transformer inference process
Develops efficient relaxation algorithm for determining optimal partition schemes and quantization parameters
Designs dedicated encoding/decoding strategies for efficient accelerator implementation
First viable scheme achieving full 6-bit quantization of vision transformers with acceptable accuracy
